'''Armed conflicts and attacks'''
*[[Syrian conflict (2024–present)|Syrian conflict]], [[Israeli invasion of Syria (2024–present)|Israeli invasion of Syria]]
**The [[Israel]]i [[Israeli Defense Forces|military]] launches a raid in [[Beit Jinn]], [[Syria]], targeting unknown gunmen and carrying out [[airstrike]]s, killing 13 [[Syrians]], including two children, and wounding 25 others. Six Israeli soldiers are also wounded in a [[shootout]] with local residents. Israel says it was targeting [[Islamic Group (Lebanon)|Jaama Islamiya]]. [https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2025/11/28/israeli-forces-syrians-clash-in-damascus-countryside-casualties-reported (Al Jazeera)] [https://www.bbc.com/news/articles/cp89k31krz4o (BBC News)] [https://www.jpost.com/israel-news/defense-news/article-876513 (''The Jerusalem Post'')]

'''Disasters and accidents'''
*[[2025 North Indian Ocean cyclone season]]
**[[Cyclone Senyar]]
***The toll from the [[flood]]s in [[Indonesia]] increases to 174 people killed and 80 more missing, mainly in [[North Sumatra]]. [https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2025/11/28/flood-deaths-rise-to-174-in-indonesia-surge-across-southeast-asia (Al Jazeera)]
***The death toll from the floods in [[Thailand]] increases to 145 people, mainly in [[Songkhla province]]. [https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2025/11/28/death-toll-from-flooding-in-southern-thailand-reaches-at-least-145 (Al Jazeera)]
**[[Cyclone Ditwah]]
***The toll from the [[landslide]]s caused by heavy rains in [[Sri Lanka]], mainly between [[Badulla]] and [[Nuwara Eliya]], increases to 56 people killed and 600 houses damaged. [https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2025/11/28/sri-lanka-landslides-floods-death-toll-rises-to-56-offices-schools-shut (Al Jazeera)]
*Two [[Tanker (ship)|tankers]] sanctioned as being a part of the alleged [[Russian shadow fleet]] are hit by explosions while transiting the [[Bosporus]], with at least one of the vessels catching on fire. [[Turkey]] says [[search and rescue]] operations are underway to evacuate the crew members. [https://www.reuters.com/world/tanker-hit-by-blast-fire-north-turkeys-bosphorus-strait-agency-says-2025-11-28/ (Reuters)]

'''International relations'''
*[[Honduras–United States relations]]
**[[United States]] [[President of the United States|president]] [[Donald Trump]] announces that he will [[Federal pardons in the United States|pardon]] former [[Honduras|Hondura]]n [[President of Honduras|president]] [[Juan Orlando Hernández]], who is serving a [[Incarceration in the United States|U.S. prison]] sentence for [[Illegal drug trade in the United States|drug-trafficking]] offenses. [https://www.france24.com/en/live-news/20251128-trump-says-pardoning-honduras-ex-president-days-before-vote (AFP via France 24)]

'''Science and technology'''
*[[2025 Airbus A320 software update]]
**[[Airbus]] launches an emergency [[software update]] on [[Airbus A320|A320]] aircraft worldwide to prevent potential corruption to [[guidance system]]s caused by intense [[solar radiation]], affecting 6,000 planes, causing major travel disruptions worldwide. [https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/live/cvg4y6g74ert (BBC News)]
*A team of scientists announces the detection of [[electric discharge]]s in the [[atmosphere of Mars]] for the first time by [[NASA]]'s [[Perseverance (rover)|''Perseverance'']] [[mars rover|rover]], detected near the [[Jezero (crater)|Jezero crater]] region, as a phenomenon described as "mini lightning", though not confirmed to be the same as actual [[lightning]].
